annotations.title: How much home loan can I afford?

description: Largest home loan a monthly take-home pay supports, the way Indian banks work it out: all EMIs together within a share of take-home pay (FOIR, default 50%), and RBI's loan-to-value limits (90% of the home's value up to Rs 30 lakh, 80% up to Rs 75 lakh, 75% above). Optionally checks whether a given home price fits, with the EMI and down payment. Stamp duty and registration (about 6-8%) are extra and not financed.

emi_share_percent.description: Share of take-home pay all EMIs may use, % (default 50; banks allow about 50-60%)

existing_monthly_emis.description: Other EMIs already being paid each month, in rupees (default 0)

home_price.description: Optional: price of a home to check, in rupees, without stamp duty

name: home_loan_affordability
